title: Loan default risk
goal: Show an interpretable risk-classification tree with sample counts and class distributions.

rubric.must: Income is visibly the root split, with low- and higher-income branches.
Credit score is visibly used below income and employment years visibly refine the lower-income, higher-credit branch.
Visible leaves include low-risk, elevated-risk, and high-risk classifications.
Split and leaf boxes visibly show sample counts and class-value counts.
The low-income and low-credit path visibly terminates at a high-risk leaf.
Every displayed split has visually distinct true and false branches.

ideal.notes: Existing independent target retained; corrected relation labels and arrow-tip registration to match the source.

review.evidence: Visually reviewed against the ML exemplar and source: four split rules, five predictions, source class counts and sample counts remain visible. Relation labels now show the authored thresholds. Leaf class headers, class-mix bars and aligned outcome cards are distinct and readable.
